title: Retail Installment Contracts System Reference: Booking a Returned-Payment Fee
content:
**Policy entry.** On Retail Installment Contracts, a returned-payment fee is booked on the contract's latest returned payment — the return with the latest return date, and among returns of the same date the one recorded first — when its return reason is one of the product's fee-bearing return reasons. When the fee worked out for it is zero, no fee is booked.

A fee-bearing return carries the returned-payment fee as a returned-payment fee linked to the return and dated on the return date, unless the product's monthly cap of returned-payment fees is already reached by fees assessed and unwaived on the contract in that calendar month, in which case no fee is assessed.

## Capability

`assess_returned_payment_fee_c98c0726` books a returned-payment fee for one payment the bank returned unpaid. One call adds a single returned-payment fee entry linked to that return, dated on the date the return was received, and raises the contract's fees due by the amount charged; the borrower sees the fee on the contract and in the fees owed. The tool records the amount passed and works out nothing.

## How it is invoked

An agent-side tool: the representative unlocks `assess_returned_payment_fee_c98c0726` and calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `contract_id` | the contract reference number of the retail installment contract being charged, as returned by the contract lookup for the verified borrower | text identifier |
| `related_txn_id` | the ledger reference number of the return entry (the returned-payment record) the fee is charged for, as returned by the contract money-history lookup | text identifier |
| `amount_usd` | the returned-payment fee amount | USD, 2 decimal places, 0.00 or more; stored rounded half-up to the cent exactly as passed |

## Return

A receipt rendered as text with `contract_txn_id` (ledger reference of the new fee entry), `contract_id`, `related_txn_id` (the return the fee is linked to), `txn_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the date the return was received), `amount_usd` (the fee booked, 2 decimal places), `fees_due_usd` (the contract's fees due including this fee, 2 decimal places) and `status`, the text booked, meaning the fee is now owed. A receipt carrying the new ledger reference means the fee is booked.

**Q&A.** *Which date does the fee carry when it is booked days after the return arrived?* The date the return was received, not the booking day.
